access_limits: Operator sites (Shell, bp, BHP) and Subsea 7 returned script-only pages, HTTP 403 or a bot challenge. Shell releases were therefore read as wire-service copies (PR Newswire and its syndication); bp releases could not be opened at all, and the older bp release URLs now redirect to a listing page.
OnePetro (OTC/SPE/JPT abstracts) returned HTTP 403. **No paper-class rows.**
PDFs could not be parsed on this host (BSEE weekly deepwater activity reports, a co-owner start-up release, contractor PDF releases). **No regulator-class rows.**

SEC filings opened, but long 20-F documents were read in 100,000-character windows through a summarising fetch tool; a sentence can be missed. Where a snippet claims a sentence I did not see, it is marked unverified.
